import itertools, random

def is_costas(p):
    n = len(p)
    seen = set()
    for d in range(1, n):
        for i in range(n-d):
            v = (d, p[i+d]-p[i])
            if v in seen: return False
            seen.add(v)
    return True

random.seed(1)
n=11
# backtracking
def solve():
    p=[-1]*n
    used=[False]*n
    vecs=set()
    def bt(c):
        if c==n: return True
        order=list(range(n))
        random.shuffle(order)
        for r in order:
            if used[r]: continue
            p[c]=r
            new=[]
            ok=True
            for cc in range(c):
                v=(c-cc, r-p[cc])
                if v in vecs or v in new:
                    ok=False; break
                new.append(v)
            if ok:
                for v in new: vecs.add(v)
                used[r]=True
                if bt(c+1): return True
                used[r]=False
                for v in new: vecs.discard(v)
        p[c]=-1
        return False
    if bt(0): return p
    return None

sol=solve()
print(sol, is_costas(sol))
